info.title: SmartOmni TikTok Shop Simulator API
info.description: Local simulator used to test SmartOmni's TikTok Shop integration. Three separate routers: **TikTok-shaped public API** (root paths, what SmartOmni calls), **Demo** (`/demo/*`, Seller/Buyer UI) and **Test admin** (`/test-admin/*`, seed/reset/clock/faults). All data is fake. TikTok contracts are still `unverified` (see docs/support-matrix.md); error codes are simulator faults, not TikTok codes.
